messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-045 triggered -> routing-service high error rate, spike in 5xx and latency for /embeddings (sev: page)

sam (sre-oncall): I'm on call, joining. seeing surge of embed->chat fallbacks and TTL misses.

mei (eng-runtime): digging into model-router logs now. Route resolve shows alias `embed-us-west` pinned to `redwood-chat-v2` (chat) not an embedding-capable variant.

anya (ml-infra): 😬 that's bad. Did a pin happen in the release? checking pin history...

ben (eng-ml): Confirming: requests with `input_type=embedding` are ending up at a chat runtime, returning text chunks and 500s when consumer expects vectors.

sam (sre-oncall): Customer impact? any top customers hit? Jordan?

jordan (product-ops): Customer-support says several enterprise customers reported degraded search quality and timeouts. Ticket counts rising. I'll coordinate comms.

customer-support: Notifying impacted customers (Acct A, Acct B, Acct C) now. ETA for initial message: 15m.

mei (eng-runtime): Quick repro: two example requests sent to /v1/embeddings returned text tokens and 502s. Logs: `resolved_variant=chat-v2, expected_interface=embeddings`

ben (eng-ml): Root cause hypothesis: deployment job accidentally pinned the `embed` alias to the chat build artifact during canary. The pin shows up in the pin table at version `2026-03-14-release-17`

anya (ml-infra): I'm going to remove the errant pin and route override immediately. Command: `redwoodctl pins delete alias/embed-us-west --force`

mei (eng-runtime): Also applying routing override so embedding endpoints prefer `embed-quant-v1` until we validate. Command: `redwoodctl route override --alias embed-us-west --variant embed-quant-v1 --ttl 600`

sam (sre-oncall): Rolling back pinned alias now. Monitoring traffic.

incident-bot: Action logged: pin removal initiated by anya at controller-01.

mei (eng-runtime): Rollback applied. Verified `resolved_variant=embed-quant-v1` for new calls. Error rate falling from ~18% to ~1.2% in last 2m.

jordan (product-ops): Customer-support: please send a short update: we've mitigated faulty routing and are monitoring. Provide RCA to customers once incident is closed.

customer-support: Sent updates to impacted accounts. They asked for ETA on full rollback and data correctness checks.

ben (eng-ml): We should run quick sanity checks on embedding outputs for the window affected (approx 00:16-00:48 UTC). Will run vector validation job against sample set.

sam (sre-oncall): Running canary traffic simulation and checking latency percentiles. No further fallback loops observed.

mei (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation complete. Long-term fix: block alias pins that mismatch interface type during release, add CI check in release pipeline. Filing follow-up issue.

anya (ml-infra): Creating infra ticket: "release pipeline allowed cross-interface alias pin" -> P0 for next sprint.

ben (eng-ml): Early analysis: ~0.8% of total embedding requests in the window returned incompatible responses; correlated to 3 customers with heavy traffic.

jordan (product-ops): Will prepare customer-facing RCA draft with timeline and mitigations.

sam (sre-oncall): Marking incident as mitigated; keeping channel open for 2h monitoring. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status -> mitigated (monitoring). PagerDuty auto-note added.

mei (eng-runtime): Postmortem owners: mei + ben + anya. Will sync tomorrow.

customer-support: Customers acknowledged update; asking for vector refresh guidance. Passing to eng-ml for guidance.

ben (eng-ml): Will send recommended steps for re-ingestion/refresh and a script to detect corrupt vectors.

sam (sre-oncall): Closing active page. Leave this thread open for final postmortem attachments.

incident-bot: Thread closed for paging; notifications silenced.
